item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
UFB 1.0.12

  • HEIC photos get real thumbnails: iPhone photos (.heic/.heif) now render thumbnails and full lightbox previews on both Windows and macOS, decoded natively via libheif. Multi-tile iPhone captures and EXIF rotation are handled correctly.
  • Renamed iPhone photos too: photos that transfer tooling renamed to .jpg (while leaving HEVC data inside) previously showed no thumbnail at all. UFB now detects the real format from the file contents and previews them regardless of extension.

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
UFB 1.0.11

  • Mounts no longer hang at login (macOS): A mount aimed at a server that isn't reachable yet (VPN still connecting after a restart) could stall forever and never recover. Mount attempts now probe the server first and run under a deadline — an unreachable server fails fast and retries automatically until it comes back.
  • Stale mountpoint "Fix" pill (macOS): When a leftover /Volumes folder from an interrupted mount forces a share onto a "-1" name, the mount row now explains exactly that and offers a one-click Fix… that removes the leftover (one admin prompt) and remounts on the clean name. A genuinely foreign volume occupying the name is still left alone.
  • Sidebar pill clicks: Inline action pills on mount rows (Sign in…, Fix…) could silently ignore clicks — fixed.

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
UFB 1.0.9

  • AE tab — renders/proxies subtabs: After Effects folder tabs now show a subtab strip on the bottom pane, switching between the renders (default) and proxies subfolders. The choice is remembered per folder, and Tracker reveal links open the matching subtab.

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
UFB 1.0.8

  • New update home: updates are now delivered from ufbrowser.com, with downloads hosted on GitHub Releases. This release completes the move — no app-functionality changes.
